items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: oh yeah, Henry Prince? Yeah, Henry Prince was the pianist, which was the bass player that was with Nat at first ... his name was Prince, Wesley Prince. Wesley Prince's brother.

ctx.x: And Marshall Royal was in the band playing lead

alto; Marvin Johnson was playing third alto; that's when they were just using three saxaphones, and the tenor player was Chuck someone -- you know, I don't know, or remember him, but I do remember ... oh yeah, Henry Prince? Yeah, Henry Prince was the pianist, which was the bass player that was with Nat at first ... his name was Prince, Wesley Prince. Wesley Prince's brother.

This guy was playing piano with Les Hyte's band, and I was trying to remember the trombone player -- Sonny Gravin was the trombone player. See, the reason they're kind of rough is because in later years I got to know them better, you know, when I finally was accepted, and then I knew them better. But I was just trying to run down -- oh, and the bass player -- I don't know the bass player with Les's band, but that night, all the younger musicians thought that Buck Clayton's band cut Les Hyte's band, you know, but…
